redfin.remarks: Rare opportunity to own a top-floor ocean-view studio in one of Redondo Beach's most desirable locations. These coveted units seldom come on the market, making this an incredible chance for a primary residence, beach retreat, or investment property. Wake up to ocean views, enjoy spectacular sunsets, and experience the best of South Bay coastal living. The top-floor location provides added privacy, abundant natural light, and a peaceful setting that's hard to find; this turnkey studio perfectly blends casual coastal charm with modern, high-end updates. The bright and airy living area is accented by a custom wood-paneled wall, a tropical ceiling fan, and modern light fixtures. It flows seamlessly into a completely remodeled gourmet kitchen featuring rich wood countertops, premium stainless steel appliances and a beach-inspired tile backsplash. The standout feature is the incredibly smart, space-maximizing layout that offers unparalleled versatility. The main area effortlessly transitions from a wide-open entertaining haven by day into a comfortable bedroom by night, thanks to dual custom Queen-size Murphy beds. These beds are beautifully concealed within sleek white cabinetry when folded away, instantly opening up the floor plan. This entire space extends outdoors to a private balcony that offers beautiful white-water views and catches the fresh ocean breeze, creating the ultimate backdrop for your morning coffee or sunset wind-downs. Living at The Village feels like a permanent vacation with an incredible lineup of resort-style amenities right at your doorstep. Residents enjoy access to two sparkling, year-round heated pools and spas, fitness centers, fire pits, outdoor barbecue cooking areas, and lushly landscaped grounds. Convenience is built-in with secure, subterranean assigned parking, elevator access, EV charging stations, separate guest parking, and an on-site property manager. This prime waterfront location allows you to leave your keys at home, positioning you immediately adjacent to the iconic Redondo Beach Pier, King Harbor, and pristine local beaches. You can enjoy instant access to diverse waterfront dining, vibrant local shopping, and the famous South Bay bike path that stretches from Palos Verdes all the way to Santa Monica. Whether you are looking for a turnkey vacation home, a clever entry-level beach property, or a stellar investment opportunity, this coastal gem delivers the ultimate Southern California lifestyle.
